test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the idiom that can correctly replace the underlined part of the given sentence.

It was a very important meeting, but I stayed __cool as ice__ because I knew our product was the best.
solution:
The correct answer is "cool as a cucumber"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cool as ice **is used to describe a person **who does not show any emotion, calm and relaxed**.
 
• ​**Cool as a cucumber**: *calm and relaxed*.
 
 
• *Example: she looked as efficient as a hospital matron, as cool as a cucumber*
 
 
 
• Hence, in the given sentence, '**cool as ice**' should be replaced by '**cool as a cucumber**'

 

Correct Sentence: *It was a very important meeting, but I stayed cool as a cucumber__ because I knew our product was the best.*
